tools.name: search_foods
tools.description: Find foods by name in the ANSES-CIQUAL 2020 table (3,167 foods, names in English). Returns ids to pass to get_food_nutrients.

tools.name: get_food_nutrients
tools.description: Calories, macros and up to 26 micronutrient lines (vitamins, minerals, fiber, omega-3, polyphenols) for a portion of one food, each as a share of the EU daily reference value. A nutrient the table has no value for is listed under no_value_in_table, never reported as zero.
